title: How Much Does Vinyl Plank Flooring Installation Cost in Edmonds? 2026 Prices
meta: Vinyl plank installation in Edmonds costs $2.50 per sq ft for labor at Wills Flooring, $100 per stair. See what plank and prep add, then price your rooms.
keywords: vinyl plank flooring installation cost Edmonds, LVP installation cost per square foot, luxury vinyl plank installation price 2026, Edmonds WA vinyl plank flooring, how much to install vinyl plank flooring

blocks.lead: Vinyl plank installation in Edmonds costs $2.50 per sq ft for labor at Wills Flooring, plus $100 per stair, with a 500 sq ft minimum.
blocks.detail: The plank itself, underlayment and any old-floor removal are quoted separately at the free in-home estimate. A 1,000 sq ft Edmonds rambler is $2,500 in labor; what you pay on top depends almost entirely on which plank you choose and what is under the old floor.

blocks.html: "How much is LVP installed?" is the most common question we get from Edmonds, usually from someone in a 1950s to 70s rambler in Seaview or Westgate who is tired of worn carpet, or a retiree in the Bowl who wants one durable floor through the whole condo before downsizing gets any harder. The labor rate is simple. The rest of the bill is not, so this post walks through every line you will see on a real quote and gives you a calculator to run your own rooms.

blocks.text: What $2.50 per sq ft actually buys

items.html: Layout and measuring. We plan the plank direction, stagger and where the cut rows land so you do not end up with a two-inch sliver along the main wall.
Cutting and fitting. Every plank around door jambs, closets, hearths and the odd angles that Edmonds ramblers collect after sixty years of remodels.
Click-lock or glue-down installation. Most residential plank in Edmonds is a floating click-lock floor. Glue-down is used in some condos and commercial spaces and is priced the same.
Transitions and shoe molding. Reducers to tile, T-molds at doorways and reinstalling quarter round are included. New baseboard is not.
Cleanup and haul-away of our scrap. You get a clean floor the same day, not a garage full of boxes.

blocks.text: Where the rest of the money goes

head: Line item

What drives it in Edmonds
rows: Wear layer (12 to 22 mil), core type (SPC or WPC), width and brand. We bring the samples to you and quote on the spot.
Many planks have a pad attached. Over a crawlspace or slab we may add a vapor layer, especially close to the water.
Carpet is fast. Glued sheet vinyl or old tile in a 1960s kitchen is slow and can hide asbestos backing that changes the plan.
Planks need a floor flat to about 3/16 in over 10 ft. Old ramblers with settled joists or layers of underlayment often need leveling.
Wrapped treads with a matching nosing. Split-levels in Perrinville and Esperance usually have 13 or 14.

blocks.text: Why Edmonds quotes swing so much

items.title: Flatness in older ramblers
items.text: Vinyl plank telegraphs every dip. A 1958 Westgate house with a sagged hallway may need a bag or two of leveling compound, or a full sheet of new underlayment, before the first plank goes down.

items.title: Crawlspace and salt air
items.text: Homes near the waterfront and the Bowl sit in some of the dampest air in the county. Plank itself is waterproof, but the subfloor is not, so we check moisture and add a vapor layer when the numbers say so.

items.title: The plank you pick
items.text: A 12 mil builder plank and a 22 mil rigid-core plank install for the same $2.50 labor but can differ by several dollars a foot in material. This is usually the biggest swing on any Edmonds quote.

items.title: What has to come out
items.text: Carpet and pad take an hour a room. Two layers of glued vinyl over particleboard can take a full day and change the disposal cost. We look before we quote so the number does not move later.

Dogs, kids or a rental unit
You want one floor through the whole house for under the cost of hardwood

A sunroom or south-facing room hits high temperatures with no HVAC

blocks.title: The cheapest plank costs the most:
blocks.text: A thin-core, 6 mil plank saves money on the box and shows every joint, dent and heel mark within two years. For Edmonds households that plan to stay, we steer toward a 20 mil wear layer and a rigid core. Same labor, far longer life. We explain the difference on the sample boards at the estimate.
Questions to ask before you sign any LVP quote

items.html: Is labor separate from material? A single "installed" price makes it impossible to compare. Our labor is published on the price list and the plank is a separate line.
Did you check the subfloor? If nobody pulled up a corner of carpet or looked in the crawlspace, the quote is a guess.
What wear layer and core are you quoting? Get it in writing in mils and core type. See our guide to LVP vs laminate if you are still deciding between the two.
Are stairs and transitions included? Ours are itemized at $100 per stair; transitions are part of the labor.
Who fixes it if a plank lifts? Wills Flooring backs every install with a 1-year workmanship warranty, on top of the manufacturer's material warranty.

faq.q: How much does it cost to install 1,000 sq ft of vinyl plank in Edmonds?
faq.a: Labor is 1,000 × $2.50 = $2,500 at Wills Flooring's published rate. The plank, any underlayment and removal of the old floor are added on top and quoted at the free in-home estimate, since they depend on the product you choose and what is under the current floor.

faq.q: Does the $2.50 per sq ft include the vinyl plank itself?
faq.a: No. The $2.50 is installation labor only. We bring plank samples to your house, you pick one, and we quote the material on the spot. Bundling the two into one number is how some quotes hide an overpriced plank, so we keep them separate.

faq.q: Is there a minimum job size for vinyl plank installation?
faq.a: Yes, 500 sq ft. A 300 sq ft kitchen is billed at 500 × $2.50 = $1,250 in labor. Most Edmonds customers add the adjoining hall or dining area to use the minimum fully and get a continuous floor without a transition.

faq.q: Can vinyl plank go over my existing floor?
faq.a: Often yes. Click-lock plank can float over a flat, well-adhered vinyl, tile or wood floor. It cannot go over carpet or over a floor that is out of flat by more than about 3/16 in over 10 ft. We check this at the estimate and quote any removal or leveling separately.

faq.q: How long does an LVP install take in an Edmonds home?
faq.a: Most 800 to 1,200 sq ft main floors are done in one to two days once the old floor is out. Tear-out of glued vinyl or tile can add a day. You can walk on click-lock plank the moment we finish and move furniture back the same evening.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to install vinyl plank in Edmonds?
faq.a: No. Replacing a floor covering is cosmetic work and does not require a City of Edmonds permit. Condo associations in the Bowl often require a sound-rated underlayment and a heads-up to neighbors, which we can help document.
